run.name: synthetic-example
notes: Synthetic: written by notebooks/rhvp_compare/example.py, never measured.

analysis.subject: B
analysis.pairing: a pair is side B's and side A's figure from the same round
analysis.unit: one figure per launch and case; requests are never pooled across launches
analysis.test: exact two-sided sign test over the rounds where the two figures differ; a round with equal figures is not a trial, and one paired round gives no p-value
analysis.family_rule: Holm's correction over the primary cases only; the twin comparisons and the secondary cases are outside that family, and a secondary case is graded on its uncorrected p-value, as a description
analysis.floor_rule: a side's noise floor on a group of cases is the largest abs(median(side / twin) - 1) over the group (by default the cases of one metric and role); the bar is side B's floor plus side A's
analysis.verdict_rule: outside the bar and p below alpha: FASTER or SLOWER (time), BETTER or WORSE (rates, tokens per joule); inside the bar and p not below alpha: TIE; inside but significant, or outside but not significant: UNRESOLVED; NO VERDICT when the comparison cannot be graded
